title: Add spaCy NLP tool and data manager
body:
## Summary
- Adds spaCy NLP annotation tool supporting 70+ models across 25+ languages
- Includes data manager for downloading and installing spaCy language models
- Provides tokenization, POS tagging, lemmatization, dependency parsing, NER
- Multiple output formats: JSON, CoNLL, tabular, text

## Test plan
- [x] Tool passes planemo lint validation
- [x] Data manager passes planemo lint validation
- [x] Comprehensive test data included
- [x] README documentation provided for both components
- [x] Model installation tested across multiple languages

🤖 Generated with Claude Code

There are two labels that allow to ignore specific (false positive) tool linter errors:

* `skip-version-check`: Use it if only a subset of the tools has been updated in a suite.
* `skip-url-check`: Use it if github CI sees 403 errors, but the URLs work.

To request a review once your PR is ready, comment "please review" on the PR. This will
automatically apply the `ready-for-review` label if the PR is not a draft, all review
